en: Welcome to my studio! My son Cameron takes photos of Trainers all over Johto, and Kanto too.
I'll tell him to look out for you. Every photograph he takes of you comes here, and I keep them in an album.
Would you like to look through your album?
Your album's still empty. Find my son Cameron out on his travels, and he'll take your picture.
Any time you like. The album isn't going anywhere.
